name: white-flow-vscode
description: A white VS Code theme with opt-in typing motion, switchable keyword flow, and optional workbench styling.

whiteFlow.keywordFlow.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable keyword color flow. Requires the updated optional workbench patch and the White Flow Light theme.

enumDescriptions: Purple, blue, teal, and rose with vivid OKLCH interpolation when supported.
Red, green, blue, and purple with vivid OKLCH interpolation when supported.
whiteFlow.keywordFlow.palette.markdownDescription: Palette for keyword flow. Requires the optional workbench patch.

whiteFlow.typingMotion.enabled.markdownDescription: Animate each newly typed character as it appears. Only the newest character moves, and only vertically, so the cursor and click targets stay accurate.

enumDescriptions: Use `rise` when the optional workbench patch provides its keyframes, otherwise `fade`.
Blur in and rise when the optional patch is available; otherwise fade in.
Step the opacity in with the supported decoration API only.
whiteFlow.typingMotion.style.markdownDescription: How a newly typed character appears.

whiteFlow.typingMotion.durationMs.markdownDescription: Length of the typing motion in milliseconds. Short values keep up with fast typing.
